notes.title: Minor patch for macOS / Apple Silicon
notes.notes: macOS users of both Intel and Apple Silicon (M1/M2 etc) computers should be able to launch the game without issue now.

notes.title: Cribbage Club Free Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34694204/26d94b505c615fb85a9bd076d9aa40f3228015d8.gif[/img]

We are happy to announce that our free update with our Cribbage Mini-Game is now available on Steam, Itch, and the Nintendo Switch.

Cribbage is a great two-person card game, and an old favourite of the geriatric community.  We’ve designed the game with both experienced players and first timers in mind. Thanks to our beta testers who assisted us in making the game experience as seamless as possible.

Of course, like all card games, the best way to learn is to play it yourself! The Ye OLDE gang will guide you through it on your first time, and we suggest you try it out on easy while you get the hang of things. Maybe you will bite the big one your first time out of the gate, or maybe you will discover some preternatural cribbage ability. As many seasoned card players will tell you, it’s all part of the experience.

We have hidden some story nuggets for each character within the game, so each opponent has something different to offer when you play against them.

Please join our discord at https://discord.gg/9TECBtW for cribbage tips, and if you discover any bugs.

We know you’re all chomping at the bit for Part 2. We don’t have an exact date set for release yet, but we are wrapping up production on it in the next couple of weeks. After that, it’s off for approval by the Nintendo team! Thank you for your patience, and we guarantee Part 2 will be well worth the wait.
